brief: Restored white board-and-batten gable barn about 36 ft by 50 ft on a low rubble limestone foundation, with a lean-to aisle along the far side that holds an open garage bay. Natural-wood double sliding doors on the gable end under a gooseneck barn light, a small loft window high in the gable, small four-pane windows with natural wood casings along the side. The steep metal roof is weathered to a patchy rust-red, topped by a louvered square cupola with a tall pointed spire cap.
